newsitem.title: JAPAN: TDF shares ask-only for seventh successive day.
newsitem.headline: TDF shares ask-only for seventh successive day.

text.p: Shares in TDF Corp, a Japanese car parts maker, were ask-only for a seventh consecutive business day on Monday due to reports that an investor failed to settle a large share transaction, brokers said.
The shares were ask-only at 1,300 yen as of 0331 GMT, down from Friday's ask price of 1,420 yen. The shares were last traded on January 16, when they ended at 4,120 yen.

Hectic selling interest has knocked down the shares after recent media reports about a transaction of TDF shares made through Nomura Securities Co Ltd, under which an unnamed client agreed to buy 1.7 million TDF shares at 4,200 yen but failed to pay seven billion yen by the settlement date of January 16.
A Nomura Securities spokesman told Reuters on Monday that there were misunderstandings between Nomura and the client and that negotiations were still continuing. He did not elaborate.
Officials of TDF Corp were not immediately available for comment.
